I recently stayed at this Hotel and unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience. The hygiene standards were subpar, with noticeable cleanliness issues throughout the premises. Moreover, the owner and staff were uncooperative and did not address my concerns adequately. The hotel even not providing the breakfast on time and they were not even giving the water bottle, saying they don't have. Not even able to provide warm water to drink in the morning and giving excuse that they don't have gas and the gas will come after 10 am.
The bathroom ceiling had dripping water issue.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to others due to its lack of hygiene and unhelpful staff and the way they were providing the worst service.

I even don't want to give this hotel a single star ⭐ rating but Google don't have that option available.  Check photos yourself.
